summary_blocks.current_goal: Overhaul the BrocaOS React application and Python Web API to provide a professional, visually appealing cognitive interface with robust persistence and smart session management.
what_we_built: Modular React architecture with components for Sidebar, MessageItem, and InputBar.
Cyber-tech 'Deep Space' aesthetic using glassmorphism, neon accents, and professional typography.
Stateless backend session rehydration using JSONFileStorage for persistent chat history.
AI-powered auto-titling and auto-create logic for zero-friction conversation starts.
Professional markdown rendering with preserved indentation, hierarchy (h1-h4), and syntax highlighting.
open_questions: Are there edge cases in the LLM-based title generation that might fail or produce undesirable output?
Should the '158 Capabilities' badge be dynamically linked to the actual tool registry count?
constraints: Must use TypeScript type-only imports due to project configuration (verbatimModuleSyntax).
Backend must interface with existing BrocaOS core storage and LLM clients.
next_steps: Perform final manual verification of concurrent conversation switching and persistence.
Refine error handling for streaming interruptions to prevent partial history saves.
Consider adding a 'System Capability' explorer to the UI.

evidence.claim: The React app is located in /home/wizard/broca and uses Vite and TypeScript.
The project uses JSON-based file storage for conversation history in /home/wizard/Documents/Code/BrocaOS/conversations/.
TypeScript configuration requires type-only imports (import type) for types and interfaces.
Move to a modular component structure (Sidebar, MessageItem, InputBar) for the React app.
Implement stateless rehydration in the backend using existing JSON storage.
Adopt a 'Deep Space' theme with radial gradients and Inter/JetBrains Mono fonts.
